title: Speedy Chinese Tofu and Noodles
subtitle: with Capsicum and Broccoli
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Cut the capsicum into long, thin strips. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks, then cut the head into small florets. Quarter the tofu pieces. Combine the Chinese barbecue seasoning and cornflour in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the tofu and toss to coat.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat a drizzle of vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the capsicum and broccoli for 2 mins. Add 2 tsp soy sauce and 1 tbs water (see Kitchen 101) and stir-fry for a further 2 mins or until the veggies are just tender. Remove from the pan.

Cook tofu and noodles: Heat a drizzle of vegetable oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan, reserving the pan. Meanwhile, cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Cook noodles: Return the reserved frypan to medium heat. Add half the sweet chilli sauce, 1 tbs soy sauce, 2 tsp tomato sauce, 2 tsp white vinegar and 1 tbs water and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined. Add the noodles to the sauce and stir-fry for 1 min or until combined and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with pepper.
Serve up: Divide the noodles, veggies and tofu among bowls. Drizzle with the remaining sweet chilli sauce and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Adding a little water to a hot pan while stir-frying creates steam and will ensure the broccoli stems cook through without burning, or without the need for more oil.
